# Mohammad “Matt” Namvarpour

> Information Science PhD candidate at Drexel University, Human-AI researcher, and instructor. Research focuses on human-AI interaction and conversational user interfaces, including how AI can support reflection, connection, safety, and meaningful communication. Teaches undergraduate computing and information science.
